rapport_notes: Respectful of the customer's hard budget cap (capped hours at 3 instead of pushing the higher estimate), built trust by being transparent about the adjustment.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no discovery concern surfaced; budget cap came up near the end as a constraint, not an early concern.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "we're hourly based, less time the move will take, more money at the same [save]... does that [sound fair]" then the customer responded with his own move history before the rep continued.

coaching_note: This was a post-booking confirmation call, so no close/rate-lock ask was needed or made — but the missed damage-coverage and Meet Your Mover content would still have been valuable reassurance before move day.
